name: Chetla
why: Chetla Agrani is on the doorstep and confirmed open with visitor posts; Suruchi Sangha (New Alipore, ~6 min) is the most-discussed South pandal of 2026; 66 Pally, Badamtala and Mudiali are the big-theme Kalighat/Tollygunge cluster a local walks next.

name: Gariahat
why: Ekdalia Evergreen and Singhi Park are the two marquee pandals within a few minutes' walk of Gariahat crossing; Ballygunge Cultural, Tridhara and Deshapriya Park are the Rashbehari-Gariahat Road circuit next door.

name: Deshapriya Park / Rashbehari
why: Deshapriya Park and Tridhara are steps away and both 2026 headliners; Ballygunge Cultural and Maddox Square are the classic adjacent stops; Mudiali is the closest big theme across Rashbehari.

name: Behala Chowrasta
why: Our data has few exact Behala pins, so from Behala Chowrasta every pick is a 15–20 min cab. Suruchi Sangha is South's most-discussed 2026 pandal; Ajeya Sanghati and Vivekananda Park are the Haridevpur big names; Barisha Club and Chetla Agrani are confirmed open with visitor posts. Barisha's pin is the metro station, so it is approximate.

name: Kalighat metro
why: Badamtala, Mudiali and 66 Pally are the walkable Kalighat big three; Deshapriya Park is 5 minutes east; Chetla Agrani is open and a short hop west.
